targetAudience: PMs and product leaders prioritising AI features
topic: Should this feature use AI at all?
coreInsight: Use AI only when a fixed rule can't do the job, occasional errors are acceptable or catchable, and you have data to test it; otherwise ship the rule first.

hookVariants.text: The cheapest AI feature is the one you replace with a rule.
4 questions before you add AI to anything.

selectionRationale: Highest total (23/25): plain-spoken and directly useful in roadmap reviews; the reel delivers a 4-question test with examples.

script.onScreen: THE 4 QUESTIONS / Use AI only if… / A fixed rule can’t do the job well · Occasional errors are acceptable · A wrong answer can be caught or undone · You have real data to test it on / Fail two? Ship the rule-based version first.

caption:
Some of the best AI product decisions are “no AI here”.

Use AI only if:
→ a fixed rule can’t do the job well
→ occasional errors are acceptable
→ a wrong answer can be caught or undone
→ you have real data to test it on

Fail two of the four? Ship the rule-based version first and revisit with data.

Save this for your next roadmap review.
